about: Curated plugins this runtime can propose. Advisory only: a document embeds the url + sha384 it installed, so a catalog that disappears costs convenience, not correctness. A version's url MUST serve one self-contained ES module — the loader evaluates verified bytes from a blob:, where bare and relative specifiers cannot resolve (see docs/PLUGINS.md).

nanoid.label: Nano ID
nanoid.description: Tiny id generator (477 bytes, no imports). Useful to a plugin that needs stable ids: nanoid(), customAlphabet().
